HP Victus 15 (15-fa0666TX) vs Dell G15 5530 (i5-13450HX / RTX 3050 6GB)

Side-by-side spec analysis, real GPU wattage (TGP) comparison, display quality breakdown, and clear value verdict for Indian buyers.

🏆 Winner Recommendation: Dell G15 5530 (i5-13450HX / RTX 3050 6GB)

We recommend the Dell G15 5530 (i5-13450HX / RTX 3050 6GB) as the overall winner in this matchup due to its higher 95W GPU TGP (vs 50W), superior frame rates in AAA benchmarks. However, consider the HP Victus 15 (15-fa0666TX) if you prefer its specific brand ecosystem or aesthetic design.

Why Choose HP Victus 15 (15-fa0666TX)?

  • Sophisticated, stealthy office-friendly design without aggressive gamer accents
  • Audio tuned by Bang & Olufsen (B&O) sounds crisp and loud

Why Choose Dell G15 5530 (i5-13450HX / RTX 3050 6GB)?

  • Alienware-derived thermal engineering keeps components cool under load
  • Full 1TB SSD included standard at sub-₹70k price point
